svg.text: Your machine, Git Bash on Windows
holds the decrypted key in memory,
The private key never travels. ssh proves you hold it by having the agent sign a challenge with it.
Blue = you run it. Green = a running process. Yellow = a file SSH reads. Purple = your key pair. Orange = a shell startup file. Pink = GitHub. A page glyph marks every box that is a file on disk.
